item.title: In 1942, 24-year-old WWII pilot vanished over Egypt, 84 years later, his family finally buried him
item.description: After eight long decades, Captain Marvin Lancaster was laid to rest in North Carolina. His fighter plane was shot down over Egypt during WWII in 1942, and for years, his identity remained a mystery. Thanks to advanced DNA matching, his family finally received closure, gathering to remember his bravery and sacrifice on National POW MIA Recognition Day, a day dedicated to honoring the missing servicemen and women. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: West Virginia teen builds low-cost bionic hand, selected for national science competition
item.description: Kianoosh Nawai, an eighth-grader from West Virginia Virtual Academy, has been selected as the state’s only finalist in the 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge.
